text: DSH Bottom Info Bar 是面向 DSH Web 与桌面宿主的插件，在输入框下方替换统计行，显示当前服务商与模型、余额或订阅额度、本月账单、峰谷价格和会话花费。它按提供商读取账户信息，跟踪会话用量并写入本地账本；设置页可调整字段、颜色、时区和语言，也支持导出或清除账单。适合想在对话界面查看模型成本与账户额度的 DSH 用户。使用相应余额或账单服务时需在 DSH 配置凭据或登录账户；插件本身不要求额外 API Key。

DSH Bottom Info Bar replaces the composer statistics row with the provider, model, balance or quota, billing, and session spend. It tracks usage locally and lets users customize fields, colors, and time zones or export records. Provider credentials or sign-in in DSH are needed for account data.
想在 DSH 对话框下面直接看模型和余额。
帮我统计每个会话大概花了多少。
订阅的额度还剩多少、什么时候重置？
我想在底栏查看今天和近 30 天的模型开销。
能不能把模型价格和高峰空闲时段也显示出来？
希望按自己的习惯隐藏底栏字段并调整颜色。
我想把本地记录的用量账单导出成 CSV。
DSH 有没有能显示多家模型服务账户余额的插件？
Show my model, balance, and session spend under the DSH composer.
Track local usage costs across DSH sessions.
Display remaining subscription quota and reset times in DSH.
Export my locally recorded model billing history.
DSH Bottom Info Bar 的功能「多家服务余额」：读取支持服务的账户余额，并按提供商展示余额及可用的充值或赠送余额明细。信息栏随当前会话的服务商更新。
DSH Bottom Info Bar 的功能「订阅额度」：读取支持的订阅服务额度窗口、剩余额度与重置时间；设置可选择按已用或剩余比例显示。
DSH Bottom Info Bar 的功能「峰谷价格」：根据模型价格目录计算调用花费，并显示峰谷时段与下一次价格切换时间。未收录价格的模型不套用其他模型价格。
DSH Bottom Info Bar 的功能「本地用量账本」：记录模型响应的 token 用量与费用，并提供会话、今日、近 30 天和累计视图。记录保存在本机数据库。
DSH Bottom Info Bar 的功能「信息栏设置」：在插件设置页控制字段显隐、颜色、信息密度、时区和自定义文字，并调整订阅额度百分比方向。
DSH Bottom Info Bar 的功能「导出或清除账单」：从插件设置页分批导出账单为 CSV 或 JSON，也可清除本插件记录的账单数据。
DSH Bottom Info Bar 的功能「插件更新」：设置页可查看版本、检查或安装更新，并切换自动或手动更新方式；更新后需重启 DSH 生效。
DSH Bottom Info Bar 的本地用量账本从插件开始记录时起累计，因此启用前发生的调用不计入插件统计；记录保存在本机数据目录。
DSH Bottom Info Bar 查询提供商余额、订阅或账单时会请求对应服务接口；可用数据取决于服务商接口以及 DSH 中的登录状态或凭据配置。

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Join the DeepThinking beta group： Bugs, questions and feature requests get answered fastest in the group — scan the code, say what you hit or what you want next, and it moves up the queue. The QR code expires periodically; open an issue if it has stopped working.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Join the DeepThinking beta group：A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an account information row under the composer: provider and model, real balance or subscription quota, peak/off-peak pricing, and what this session has cost.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · What it shows：The bar follows the active session and picks one of three readings per provider (mutually exclusive, nothing to switch by hand): **balance** shows the real balance from the provider's own API, **subscription quota** shows each quota window's remaining allowance with its reset countdown (an exhausted window stays visible at 0% instead of disappearing, flagged low), and **cloud billing** shows this month's real spend from the official billing API. On top of that come four spend tallies — this session, today, last 30 days, all time — plus extras such as time and custom text. All four come from the plugin's own ledger, which **starts counting when the plugin first runs**: calls made before that (or before you cleared the ledger) are not included, and hovering the spend writes out the exact start of the count. For the authoritative figure for a whole session, use the provider's own balance or bill. In balance mode, hovering the balance expands it into topped-up and granted balances, so gifted credit is never conflated with the money you paid in.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · What it shows：On **DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 with the native activity/usage buttons**, the native line sits on top and the plugin's account information on the line below. Clicking any plugin field still switches between **Full** and **Compact** with the same height/fade animation: Full shows the native line, Compact collapses it. The native buttons keep their own click behavior and open Harness's details dialogs. Each of the two native buttons can be hidden separately from the plugin's settings page. The context ring keeps its existing details and plugin settings.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · What it shows：On **older hosts**, clicking the bar still switches between **Full** and **Compact**: Full keeps the legacy statistics row, Compact collapses it. Plugin fields remain identical in both modes. Compatibility is detected from the host's live extension entries, rather than a version string.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Install：Recommended: open the DSH plugin page, choose **Add plugin**, and enter the npm package name — DSH fetches the published package from npm, with no commands and no build:

```
dsh-bottom-info-bar
```

Prefer the terminal? The same install from the command line:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bottom-info-bar
```

To run the newest code from the default branch instead of the latest release, paste the repository URL into the same field:

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Install：```
https://github.com/songoao25/dsh-bottom-info-bar
```

Then **restart DSH** — plugins are composed when the host starts, so a page refresh is not enough. In the desktop app, use **Plugins → Add plugin**; its profile is managed by the app and cannot be installed into through the CLI. Other install methods (including Windows PowerShell) and troubleshooting: [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md).

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Install：The context usage ring keeps the native hover tooltip and opens a statistics panel when clicked. Both overlays render outside the bottom bar so they do not change its contents.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Settings：Plugin settings live under **Plugins → bottom-info-bar** and save as you change them. **Plugin information** and **notices** keep their field switches and colors. On modern hosts, **native information** offers one switch per native button (session stats / usage) so either entry can be hidden; the obsolete per-field statistics-row controls are omitted from the page, search results and enabled counts. Their saved values are retained for older hosts. Older hosts still show the native field controls. Resetting plugin fields or colors does not change Harness's native button preferences.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Settings：Plugin information is further grouped by billing mode — read only the block that matches your provider; each block's heading says which items carry data for it. Time zones, custom text, quota percentage direction and billing data are separate sections:

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Settings：API keys go in DSH under **Settings → Models**; subscriptions (Codex, OpenCode, Xiaomi Token Plan, Command Code, MiniMax) read the local sign-in, and MiniMax requires a Subscription Key. Anything off the list gets a not-supported hint instead of borrowed numbers.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Spend and updates：The ledger requires a DSH runtime with Node.js 22.13 or newer. It keeps records and historical session indexes in a local disk database, reads bounded batches, and streams exports. Existing ledger files are migrated once and retained for recovery; see [Ledger storage and recovery](docs/LEDGER.md).

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Spend and updates：Every model response records one entry (usage × unit price, locked the moment the response completes) and survives restarts. The plugin checks npm once per DSH start: **automatic updates** (default) download in the background and take effect after you restart, **manual updates** only notify; a bad release can be rolled back from settings. The ledger stores tokens and amounts, never conversation content; data stays under this end's `DSH_HOME` in `dsh-bottom-info-bar/` (default `~/.dsh/dsh-bottom-info-bar/`, overridable via `DSH_BOTTOM_INFO_BAR_DATA_DIR`) and survives uninstall — export or clear it from Billing data if you want a clean slate.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Uninstall and roll back：Remove the plugin on the DSH plugin page (or `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bottom-info-bar`) and restart DSH: the native stats row comes back by itself and no plugin files are left behind. The ledger is kept on purpose — export or clear it from **Billing data** before removing the plugin if you want a clean slate. To go back a version instead, the update section offers **roll back to the previous version** while a newer build is waiting for a restart, and after a failed update. Details: [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md).

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · Languages：The plugin includes English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Hindi and Indonesian. It follows DSH’s language by default. Choose **Language** on this plugin’s settings page to use a different language independently; the choice is saved in this browser. Regional variants such as Spanish (Mexico) and Portuguese (Brazil) use the corresponding built-in language. Unsupported languages fall back to English.

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · 加入内测群 DeepThinking： 问题和需求群里反馈解决得最快——扫码进内测群，直接说遇到的问题或者想要的功能，我们会优先安排。二维码有有效期，扫不动了就在 issue 里说一声。 DeepSeek Harness 插件：把输入框下方那行统计栏换成一行信息栏——服务商与模型、真实余额或订阅额度、高峰/空闲定价，以及本会话已经花了多少。

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · 它显示什么：信息栏跟随当前会话，按服务商自动选择三种口径之一（互斥，不用手动切）：**余额制**显示官方接口的真实余额，**订阅制**显示各额度窗口剩余额度与重置倒计时（额度用尽时窗口仍显示 0%，不会从信息栏消失，并标红提示「低」），**云账单制**显示官方账单接口的本月真实花费。之外还有本会话/今天/近 30 天/累计四档花费，以及时间、自定义文字等通用项。这四档都来自插件自己的账本，**从插件开始运行那一刻起记账**：装上之前（或清除账单之后）已经发生的调用不在其中，把鼠标停在花费上会写明统计起点；要整场会话的权威数字，请以服务商的余额或账单为准。余额制下把鼠标停在余额上，会展开「充值余额 / 赠金余额」两行明细，赠送的那部分不再是糊涂账。

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · 它显示什么：**DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 提供新版原生统计按钮时**，原生那一行在上、插件账户信息在下。点击插件信息行的任意字段仍可切换**完整/简洁**，保留原来的高度收合与淡出动画：完整显示原生行，简洁把它收起。原生两个按钮保留自己的点击行为，点开是 Harness 的明细弹窗；也可以在插件设置页分别隐藏这两个原生按钮。上下文圆环继续保留现有明细和插件设置。

**旧宿主**仍保留点击信息栏切换**完整/简洁**：完整显示旧统计行，简洁收起它；插件字段在两种模式下一致。兼容方式通过实际扩展入口判断，不依赖版本号猜测。

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · 安装：最推荐：打开 DSH 的插件页 → **添加插件**，在「包名或地址」里填 npm 包名——DSH 会直接从 npm 下载已发布的版本，不用敲命令，也不用构建：

```
dsh-bottom-info-bar
```

习惯用终端？命令行装的是同一个包：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bottom-info-bar
```

想跑默认分支上的最新代码而不是已发布的版本，就在同一个输入框里填仓库地址：

```
https://github.com/songoao25/dsh-bottom-info-bar
```

然后**重启 DSH**（插件在宿主启动时组合，只刷新页面不够）。桌面客户端请使用**插件 → 添加插件**；它的配置由客户端管理，不能通过命令行安装。其他装法（含 Windows PowerShell）与排障见 [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md)。

上下文占用圆环保留原生悬浮提示，点击可打开统计面板。提示和面板都显示在底栏外层，避免出现时改动底栏内部。

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · 设置：插件设置都在**插件 → bottom-info-bar**，改完自动保存。**插件信息**和**提醒信息**保留各自的开关与配色。新版的**原生信息**为两个原生按钮各提供一个开关（会话统计 / 用量统计），可以分别隐藏；旧统计行的逐字段控件不再显示，也不计入搜索结果和启用数量，旧设置仍保留供旧宿主使用。旧宿主继续显示原生字段控件。重置插件字段或颜色不会改动 Harness 原生按钮的偏好。

「插件信息」里再按计费方式分块——你用哪种服务，就只看哪一块，哪几项有数据的说明写在块标题旁。时区、自定义文字、订阅窗口方向、账单数据是独立设置区：

密钥填在 DSH 的**设置 → 模型**；订阅类（Codex、OpenCode、小米 Token Plan、Command Code、MiniMax）读本机登录，MiniMax 必须用 Subscription Key。列表里没有的服务商只会显示未适配提示，绝不借用别家的数据。

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · 花费与更新：账本需要 DSH 内部运行环境为 Node.js 22.13 或更新版本。账目和历史会话保存在本机磁盘，按需分批读取，导出直接下载。升级会迁移旧账，但保留旧文件供恢复核对；详见 [账本存储与恢复](docs/LEDGER.md)。

每次模型响应记一条（用量 × 单价，单价在响应完成时锁定），重启不丢。插件每次随 DSH 启动检查一次新版本：**全自动更新**（默认）下载好等你重启生效，**手动更新**只提示不下载；新版有问题可以在设置页回滚到上一版。账本只记 token 与金额，不记对话内容；数据存放在本端 `DSH_HOME` 下的 `dsh-bottom-info-bar/` 目录（默认 `~/.dsh/dsh-bottom-info-bar/`，可用 `DSH_BOTTOM_INFO_BAR_DATA_DIR` 覆盖），卸载不删——要清零去设置页的账单数据里导出或清除。

dsh-bottom-info-bar README · 卸载与回退：在 DSH 插件页移除（或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bottom-info-bar`）后**重启 DSH**：原生统计栏会自动恢复，插件代码不留残留。账本是有意保留的——想彻底清零，先在设置页「账单数据」里导出或清除，再卸载。只想退回上一版的话，在有新版本等待重启时、以及更新失败后，设置页的更新区会给出**回滚到上一版**。细节见 [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md)。
dsh-bottom-info-bar README · 语言：插件内置简体中文、繁体中文、英语、日语、韩语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、法语、德语、意大利语、俄语、印地语和印度尼西亚语。默认跟随 DSH 的语言；也可以在本插件设置页的**语言**中单独选择，选择会保存在当前浏览器。墨西哥西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语等地区变体使用对应的内置语言；不支持的语言显示英语。

节假日计价已覆盖国务院公布的 2026 年中国放假调休日期。后续年份需在年度通知公布后更新日历；未收录年份使用周一至周五/周末规则。调休上班的周末仍为空闲价，已冻结的历史费用保持不变。
